name: mRAG-benchmark-docvqa
description: mRAG-benchmark-docvqa evaluates multimodal document question answering with retrieval-augmented generation across document images and associated text. It measures a system's ability to retrieve relevant document context and generate or extract correct answers to document-centric questions. The benchmark is intended for evaluating end-to-end multimodal retrieval+QA pipelines.
evaluation_method: exact_match and F1 (answer-level metrics), sometimes normalized string matching for generated answers
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face dataset used by researchers working on retrieval-augmented multimodal document QA; modest but growing adoption.
